messages:
Samir Patel: Starting a canary for recommendation-service chart -> 2.4.0. Rolling 10% first, values override to reduce replicas to 2 for the canary. Will monitor error-rate and p50 latency.
deploy-bot: Triggered helm rollout: helm upgrade --install recommendation-service ./charts/recommendation --namespace prod --set image.tag=2.4.0 --set replicas=2 --wait --timeout=5m (canary: 10%) :rocket:
Jules: noted. are we pinning the chart in values.yaml for this release or relying on image tag?
Samir Patel: pinning chart under chart.lock for the release pipeline. Image is pinned via ci tags. We still need to ensure runtime config hasn't regressed: reduced batch_size from 64 -> 32 in values-canary.yaml
Olivia: quick perf check: the last run in staging showed a 6% p50 increase with batch_size=32 for long tails. keep an eye.
Kai: Ops question — if error-rate crosses 2% do we rollback automatically or promote to 0% canary and then rollback? what's the SLO for this path?
Samir Patel: policy = auto-abort at >3% errors for 2 consecutive 1m windows. For 2-3% we'll pause and alert oncall for manual decision.
deploy-bot: Canary status update: 10% traffic routed, health checks ok, no OOMs reported.
Emma (oncall): I see a small spike in 5xxs in Grafana right now, looks like about 2.4% over the last minute. digging into logs.
Samir Patel: hold the canary promotion then. don't push the 50% step until we confirm.
Olivia: logs show an NPE in the ranking transformer when payload has empty metadata. Staging didn't hit that path because we had a sanitized dataset.
Jules: can we patch quickly with a defensive check? If yes, prefer patch and re-run canary. If not, rollback.
Samir Patel: patch is small. I'll open a quick PR and build a canary image. ETA ~18min. Pinning the temporary image tag to the canary pipeline so the chart stays 2.4.0 but image = 2.4.0-rc.1
deploy-bot: Canary paused by Samir Patel. Current traffic still at 10%.
Emma (oncall): For visibility — adding a temporary alert in prod: alert if recommendation-service 5xx_rate > 1.5% for 2m.
Kai: Also adding a rollback playbook note: helm rollback recommendation-service to 2.3.7 if we need immediate revert — command: helm rollback recommendation-service 1 --namespace prod (ensure history index corresponds).
Samir Patel: PR merged, new canary image pushed: 2.4.0-rc.1 with NPE guard. Kicking canary redeploy now.
deploy-bot: Redeploy triggered: helm upgrade --reuse-values --set image.tag=2.4.0-rc.1 --wait --timeout=5m (canary remains 10%).
deploy-bot: Canary status update: 10% traffic routed, health checks ok, no increase in 5xxs for 3m.
Olivia: p50 looks stable. pushing to 50% canary in 10m if no regressions.
Emma (oncall): Monitoring dashboard shows error-rate back to baseline. removing temporary alert in 5m.
Samir Patel: Agree to promote. We'll do a staged bump: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. keep chart.lock pinned and record the chart+image in release notes.
deploy-bot: Promotion: 50% traffic routed.
deploy-bot: Promotion health: 50% ok, tail latency unchanged, errors 0.9%.
Jules: note for release notes: changed default batch_size from 64 to 32 which reduces memory at cost of small p50 increase in long tail (mitigated by transformer fix). Add a line about fallback policy -> automatic rollback on sustained >3% errors.
Samir Patel: I'll draft the release note and attach the helm values diff. Please review quickly.
Olivia: LGTM on the change, thanks for the quick patch.
deploy-bot: Final promotion: 100% traffic routed. Deployment complete.
Samir Patel: Closing thread — recording that we pinned chart 2.4.0 in chart.lock, temporary rc image replaced the main image, and rollback playbook updated. Will follow up with a short postmortem on the NPE unexpected path. :memo:
